name: @harness/cli
description: Command-line interface for HIMA planning state, hooks, artifacts, and runtime checks.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/with-build-lock.mjs --shell "tsup src/index.ts --format esm --sourcemap --clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist"
scripts.test: node ../../scripts/with-build-lock.mjs --shell "corepack pnpm --filter @harness/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @harness/adapter-codex build && corepack pnpm --filter @harness/adapter-claude build && corepack pnpm --filter @harness/adapter-hermes build && vitest run --root ../.. ../../packages/cli/test/index.test.ts"
